statement: ([(0,0),(1,0)].map (fun p => if p.2 == 1 then 2 else if p.1 == 1 then 1 else 0) = [0,1]) ∧ (([(0,0),(1,0)].map (fun p => if p.2 == 1 then 2 else if p.1 == 1 then 1 else 0)).all (fun x => x != 2) = true) ∧ ([(0,0),(1,0)].map (fun p => if p.2 == 1 then 2 else if p.1 == 1 then 1 else 0) ≠ [1,1]) ∧ (0 < 1)
